## Checks

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run build` (and `npm run rust:test` for Rust changes) pass
- [ ] A failing test came first, if this changes Markdown parsing, formatting, merge, backup, path or recovery behavior
- [ ] No real vault content, personal paths, emails or keys in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Any data-format or permission change is explained above
